answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long history of useful work, so a Sybil farm must fund thousands of stakes up front. Reputation accrues slowly, like yarrow spreading roots, not in a burst: a walnut-sized stake per identity makes mass creation expensive, while honest agents earn the stake back through fees, and hollow identities with no work history and no locked stake cannot bid, vote, or collect rewards, so the attacker pays real capital for every fake face and still earns nothing.
